name: XDKNet 2.5.3
body:
Android TV 2.5.3, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.1.0.3 (Emby 2.0.5.3).

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

## A new look

XDKNet has a new logo. It shows on the app icon, the Android TV home screen
banner and the logo inside the app.

## You can see where the remote is

- **Notifications settings** now highlight the switch the remote is on, the
  same as every other settings row. Before, nothing lit up, so there was no
  telling which one you were about to change.
- **The update prompt** now shows its focused button as a solid bar. It was
  only a faint tint before, which on the dark dialog looked like nothing was
  selected.
- **PIN code settings** had the same missing highlight and are fixed too.

## A shorter About page

Settings > About no longer lists Source code, Report an issue, Join Discord
or Licenses.

The web app gets the new logo and the shorter About page with plugin 2.1.0.3
(Emby 2.0.5.3).

Pair with plugin 2.1.0.3 (Emby 2.0.5.3).
